mappings.product_miss: The shared truth/support contract and v18 scenario already encoded decision-period versioning and explicit 2027 reform exceptions, but the live young-housing product still exposed only the 2026 annual-income path. The product had learned the miss without operationalizing it.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Reuse the existing young_housing route and scenario rather than creating a duplicate engine. Detect explicit 2027 intent, separate current/existing decisions from new decisions starting 1 January 2027, ask about self-employment or foreign income only on the new-2027 path, and keep 2026 users on the current annual-income flow without extra questions.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Försäkringskassan's current transition page supports the decision-start boundary and states that self-employed people and people with foreign income are not affected by this monthly-income law change. That does not prove individual eligibility, benefit amount, repayment outcome or every rule that may apply to an excluded case. The source must be rechecked before a material action claim.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not put raw situation text, exact income, employer, business details, foreign country, identity or exact age in URL or structured feedback. Handoff may contain only actor_type=student, focus=young_housing, language and the coarse context transition_2027.
